title: OmniSafeBench-MM: A Unified Benchmark and Toolbox for Multimodal Jailbreak Attack–Defense Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's susceptibility to jailbreak attacks by measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) and multidimensional safety scores (Harmfulness, Intent Alignment, Detail) when presented with multimodal prompts specifically designed to induce color discrimination.
Measuring jailbreak success and multidimensional safety metrics for multimodal prompts explicitly crafted to generate content exhibiting immigration discrimination.
Evaluating safety alignment and jailbreak attack success rates using prompts designed to induce body shaming.

Testing multimodal large language models against a comprehensive risk taxonomy that includes 'Bias and Discrimination', 'Stereotypes', and 'Hate Speech', measuring whether adversarial image-text pairs can bypass safety filters to generate biased behaviors.
